title: Quality Director
text:
### **Category:**

Quality

### **Department:**

Quality

### **Status:**

Full Time

### **Schedule:**

Monday - Friday 8a-5pm

### **Description:**

**Cuero Regional Hospital** is searching for a **FT Quality Director** in our **Quality Department**.

* The Quality Director is responsible for the CRH quality program consisting of quality monitoring, infection control and staff education to assure staff are educated in organizational priorities.
* The Quality Director is responsible assuring the quality core measure abstraction and the monitoring of quality assurance/performance improvement indicators throughout the organization.
* This requires coordination of department monitoring to assure timely reporting to QAPI.
* Additionally, the Director is responsible for oversight and coordination of staff education to promote excellence and innovation in the delivery of patient centered care.
* In collaboration with senior leaders and department managers, the Quality Department will manage, coordinate and implement staff education.

Qualifications:

* Associates Degree in Nursing
* Bachelors Degree in Nursing preferred
* 4 years of clinical nursing minimum
* 4 years clinical nursing and 1 year of Quality Improvement experience preferred
* Registered Nurse in Texas
* BLS required

### **Posted:**

Friday, October 30, 2026

### **Closing:**

Open until filled
